map.C-14 半衰期 5730 年，有效定年通常约 5 万年内，过老信号太弱。: The C-14 half-life is 5730 years; effective dating usually works within about 50,000 years, since older samples have too weak a signal.
map.t = (th/ln2)·ln(1/frac) 由残留比例求样本年龄。: t = (th/ln2)·ln(1/frac) derives the sample age from the remaining fraction.
map.t = T½/ln2 · ln(N₀/N)。 剩 50% 即一个半衰期。: t = T½/ln2 · ln(N₀/N). Remaining 50% is exactly one half-life.

map.对比不同残留比例的年代。: Compare the dates obtained from different remaining fractions.
map.测样品现存 C-14 活度与初始（大气）活度之比得到残留比例。: Measure the ratio of the sample remaining C-14 activity to the initial (atmospheric) activity to get the remaining fraction.
map.由剩余碳-14 比例推算样品年代。: Back-calculate the sample age from the remaining C-14 fraction.
